# Long 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
Long:Int32 value:Float32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The Long.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a Long, a 64-bit integer from -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A ULong above the limit wraps (`Long(ULong(-1))` is -1), a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) and stops at the limits if it is outside. Use [SatLong](SatLong) to stop a ULong at the limit as well. Whole numbers that are written larger than 32 bits in the program are Longs already.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Long(5000000000)
Print Long(UInt(-1))
Print Long(10000000000000000000.0)
```

```text
5000000000
4294967295
9223372036854775807
```
